title: Instance Methods
theory: An instance method is behaviour that belongs to an object. A Player object might have Heal, Jump, or AddScore methods.
Instance methods can read and change the current object's state. A method can return a value when its caller needs a result, or use void when it performs an action without returning data.
Methods should have one clear responsibility and should use parameters for information supplied by the caller.
terms: A return type meaning no value is returned.
The result sent back by a method.
An action an object can perform.
tryIt: Add Heal and IsAlive methods to your Character class.
challenge: Build a Player class with methods to add score, lose health, and report whether the player has won.
mistakes: Call instance methods on an object.
Return a value when the caller needs an answer.
summary: Instance methods give objects behaviour and allow them to manage their own state.
quiz: Where does an instance method belong?
Instance methods belong to objects created from a class.
void methods perform an action without returning a value.
How is an instance method called?
The dot accesses the method on an object.
Parameters let callers provide required information.
What should a method usually have?
Focused methods are easier to understand and test.
